power.neoorigins.sporeling_mushroom_buff: Yettarew-d tazmert mi ara yili deg tbiyumin n yigula.

power.neoorigins.sporeling_daylight_dama: Yettḍurru 1 n tikelt deg tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i tafat n yiṭij srid.

origins.neoorigins.frostborn.name: Frostborn
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.description: D aferdis n ugris d usemmiḍ  yesgres iɛdawen, yettnerni deg tayga, ma d times d Nether d wid yettḍurrun.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_aura.d: Yettnadi ɣef yeεdawen iqerben s leɛqel d ameqqran. Yeswa 2 n tfesniwin. 10 n tsinin n usebded.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_cold_buff.des: Yettaɣ-d tazmert mi ara yili deg yibiyumen n tayga isemmaḍen.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_fire_weakness: Yettwaɣ s snat n tikkal seg tmes.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.name: Tikli ɣef wegris
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.desc: Ad yerr agris deg yiḥder i tettwaliḍ. 1 n tasint n usewḥel.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_natural_armor: Ammesten ameɣlal I  agris n ugris yettḥerrik yal aẓeṭṭa.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_nether_damage: Yettawi 2 n wuguren i tasint deg Nether.
origins.neoorigins.strider.name: Strider
origins.neoorigins.strider.description: D aɣersiw n Netherland i ileḥḥun ɣef lva, yettseḥlu deg uzɣal-is  maca d asemmiḍ d waman i d-yettɣunzan.
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.d: Ur t-tettḍurru ara tmes, lavha, yiḥedran n magma d tmes.
power.neoorigins.strider_nether_buff.des: Yettnerni s tɣawla mi ara yili deg Nether.
Yettawi 2 n wuguren i tasint mi ara yili deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur.
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.name: Tiririt n Magma
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.desc: Yettseḥlu s 2 HP i tasint mi ara yeɣreq deg lavha.
power.neoorigins.strider_night_vision.de: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.strider_natural_armor.d: Ammesten ameɣlal I  aglim yeqquren s uẓru n uẓru yettawi tuyat-is ɣer deffir.
origins.neoorigins.siren.name: Siren
origins.neoorigins.siren.description: Tamseḥḥart n waman i d-ilulen deg ugaraw yeldin  tesseḥḥer iɣersiwen s tilin-is yessewhamen, tesseḥlu deg tmiwa, maca d taḥerfit, d taẓayant, teqqur deg wakal.
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.name: Tilin yessewhamen
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.description: Akk lɣaci ur k-ttḥezziben ara alamma d kečč i ten-iẓedmen d amezwaru.
power.neoorigins.siren_water_breathing.d: Yettneffis ddaw waman i lebda, yettwali akken ilaq deg waman war tagut.
power.neoorigins.siren_aquatic_speed.des: Yettɛumu s tɣawla ugar n umyurar amagnu.
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.name: Ocean Eyes
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.desc: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg talqayt n tillas. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.siren_land_slowdown.des: Iteddu s ttawil s 15% deg wakal.
power.neoorigins.siren_reduced_health.de: -2 n wulawen (-4 HP afellay). Ẓẓay, yettwabna i tezlit  ur yettwaxdem ara i uḍellaɛ.
power.neoorigins.siren_regen_in_water.de: Yettseḥlu s 1 HP i tasint mi ara yili deg waman.
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.name: Yeqqur
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.descrip: Aḍu yettruẓu ticki ur tesɛiḍ ara aman: ma teqqimeḍ aṭas deg tjumma, ad teffneḍ. Lgerra, tiɣmert n waman, aman yettneffsen neɣ abadu urmiden i d-yezzin ɣer tama-k, akk ad t-ṭṭfen.
origins.neoorigins.piglin.name: Piglin
origins.neoorigins.piglin.description: Amennuɣ n Nether i iḥemmlen uṛeɣ  yeǧhed deg uxxam, ugaden-t yimawlan-is, maca yejreḥ deg beṛṛa n Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.name: Nether Fury
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.desc: Yettaɣ-d Tazmert II mi ara yili deg Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_gold_affinity.de: Ur k-ttnadin ara yiḥellufen d yiḥellufen.
power.neoorigins.piglin_fire_immunity.de: Ur t-tettḍurru ara tmes, lavha, yiḥedran n magma d wayen akk i d-yettḍurrun.
power.neoorigins.piglin_attack_bonus.des: Yettak-d 2 n wuguren niḍen deg yiwen n umennuɣ.
power.neoorigins.piglin_overworld_weakne: Yeṭṭef-it lǧehd mi yella deg ddunit.
power.neoorigins.piglin_night_vision.des: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.piglin_soul_fire_damage: Times n terwiḥt tesserɣay s telqey  tettawi-d 0.5 n wuguren i tasint mi ara tili deg tewrirt n yijdi n terwiḥt.
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.name: Hiveling
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.description: Am tzizwit n tzizwit i yettafgen s tlelli, itteqqes iɛdawen-is s uẓru n ssem, yesseḥbibir igumma akken ad d-imɣurent. Tiferfiwin ixuṣṣen d laẓ ur nettfakka, d ssuma n trewla.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.name: Iferrawen i d-izemren
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.descrip: Zzi am useqdac n elytra  iferrawen n tzizwit ttḥerriken s tɣawla. Sit ɣef jump mi ara teɣliḍ akken ad tekkseḍ.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.name: Asekḥer n ssem
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.descript: Yessuffeɣ-d aẓru ssem ɣer yiswi-inek. Yeswa 1 n tnezmart. 6 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_crop_growth.de: Lɣella-nni i d-yezzin ɣer tama-k, tettimɣur s tɣawla.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.name: Akatar amecṭuḥ
power.neoorigins.hiveling_entity_group.d: Yettwaḥsab d amurṭupud  yezmer ad t-yeṭṭef Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_jump_boost.des: +40% n lǧehd n uneggez  iḍaṛṛen n tzizwit ad k-id-rren nnig.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_reduced_health: -3 n wulawen (-6 HP afellay). Tiferkiwin d tiferkiyin, akatar d afellay.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_hunger_drain.d: Yesseṛɣay tazmert s 50% s zzerb  tafergact tesseɛyaw.
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.name: Cinderborn
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.descriptio: D aferdis n tmes n ubulkan  ur t-tettaɣ ara tmes, yessexlaɛ i yiɣersiwen, yerna yettseḥlu s lavha  maca yečča-t waman.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fire_immunit: Ur t-tettḍurru ara tmes, lavas, iẓuran n magma d tmes  lkuca tettawi-d aglim-is.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fireball.des: Yettḍeyyiḍ-d 4 n tqecwalt timecṭuḥin n tmes deg unadi i tettwaliḍ. Yeswa 3 n teswiɛin. 5 n tsinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_natural_armo: Ammesten ameɣlal I  amagma yessismeḍ yeffer iɣerdayen.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_lava_regen.d: Yettseḥlu s 1 HP i tasint mi ara yeɣreq deg lavha.
Yettaɣ-d tazmert mi ara yili deg Lqaɛa  akal n wexxam yesseɣzay times.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_water_weakne: Aman d issem  ttḍurrun azal n 1.5 deg tasint mi ara ilin deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_night_vision: Times tagensant tfeǧǧiǧ ula d iɣeṛṛa yestullsen maḍi. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_scare_mobs.d: Tuget n yiɣersiwen ur nemɛin ara  aɣeṛsiw, imezdaɣ n taddart, iɣersiwen ur nemɛin ara  rewlen ɣef leḥdaqa-k.
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.name: Skulkburn
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.description: D amdan n tillas lqayen  yesɛan takerrust, yeṭṭef iman-is, yesɛa tazmert n umeslaw  maca d arurad, d afessas deg tafat n yiṭij, yerna yexṣer nnig n wakal.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_sonic_bolt.de: Yessuffeɣ-d asurif n ṣṣut i d-yettnadin deg 7 n yiberdan. Yessefk sin n yisekkilen n tezmert. 6 n teswiεin i d-yetteddun.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_darkness_aura: Yessuffeɣ-d aẓeṭṭa n umeslaw i d-yetteǧǧan urti n tillas deg uḍar-is. Yeswa 3 n teswiɛin. 15 n tsinin n usemmiḍ.
Yettwali amaḍal s tririyin  tallast ur tesɛi ara ugur. Rmed s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_natural_armor: Ammesten ameɣlal I  taḥnaccaḍt n usebrureq tameqqrant tessebleɛ iɣeblan i d-iteddun.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_daylight_dama: Yettḍurru s 2 n tikkal i tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_projectile_im: Tizriḍin ttwaḥerṣent s wurtan n tririt.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_vibration_sen: Imuddiren iqerben ttfeǧǧiǧen  tettḥulfuḍ i uḥerrek-nsen deg wakal.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_slow_movement: Iteddu s 15% s ttawil ɣef tannumi.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_reduced_healt: -2 n wulawen (-4 HP afellay). Tafekka yettwaxedmen s uzgen s sculk d tarẓagant.
origins.neoorigins.enderite.name: Enderit
origins.neoorigins.enderite.description: D amdan i d-ilulen seg Taggara  d bab n uḥewwes d usekḥer, d aḥnin deg uṣubbu, maca d afessas i waman d tafat n wass.
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.name: Asurif n warp

power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.name: Tafesna tilemt
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.descript: Yettɛedday s tfesniwin deg lḥiḍ. Yeswa 3 n tnezmart. 10 n tasinin n usewḥel.
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.name: Ender Drift
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.desc: Teɣli-d s leḥdaqa, amzun d taẓeyt kan i d-tetteddu.
power.neoorigins.enderite_night_vision.d: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.enderite_scare_endermit: Iɣerdayen d yiselman n wuṛeɣ ttazzalen mi ara ten-ẓren.
power.neoorigins.enderite_water_damage.d: Yettḍurru s 2 n tikkal i tasint seg unermes d waman neɣ ageffur.
power.neoorigins.enderite_daylight_weakn: Yettḍurru s 50% ugar mi ara d-yeffeɣ i tafat n yiṭij.
